title: kv-cache: defragmentation-aware eviction + spillover paging policy improvements
author: Leah Chen
description: Motivation: we continue to see suboptimal memory utilization and occasional tail-latency spikes for workloads with many short-lived contexts and heavy KV cache churn. Root causes are (1) fragmentation from variable-length KV entries, (2) inefficient eviction scanning under spillover to host memory, and (3) interactions between continuous batching and eviction which cause unbounded cache blowup during transient bursts. This PR introduces a combined approach: a defragmentation-aware allocator, an eviction scoring function that accounts for fragmentation and pinning, and an asynchronous, rate-limited spillover paging system for cold KV segments. Design summary: - New fragmentation-aware allocator (first-fit with compaction hints): tracks free-run histograms and defrag candidates, allowing lightweight in-place compaction passes when a threshold of fragmentation is reached. - Eviction policy changes: eviction score = weighted(LRU_age, access_freq, fragment_waste, pinned_penalty). This prefers evicting entries that free contiguous spans, reducing future fragmentation. - Spillover paging: cold segments can be asynchronously paged to host RAM (or optional NVMe spill), with a bounded writeback queue and throttling to avoid I/O storms. Page format is compact and uses a checksum. - Continuous batching interaction: batches now register outstanding KV pin windows so eviction defers on actively-batched requests; scheduler integrates pin-aware soft-reservations to prevent evicting entries that will be used by an in-flight batch. - Telemetry and knobs: new metrics (kv.fragmentation_ratio, kv.defrag_passes, kv.spill_io_write_bytes, kv.eviction_score_histogram) and config flags (kv.defrag_threshold_pct, kv.spill_target_bytes, kv.eviction_fragment_weight). Backwards compatibility: runtime config defaults preserve current behavior; spillover disabled by default for Dedicated clusters unless enabled via config. Checklist: - [x] allocator + defrag pass implementation - [x] eviction scoring and unit tests - [x] async spillover pipeline + unit/integration tests - [x] batching/scheduler changes and integration tests - [x] perf benchmarks and flame graphs - [x] docs and release notes Changes are implemented in ~7 files (see files_changed). See commits for the implementation history and tests.

perf_summary: Benchmarks (internal benchmark harness, 1k-token prompts, mixed short/long contexts): defrag + eviction improvements reduced KV memory fragmentation ratio from 0.42 -> 0.09 (avg), 95th-percentile token-generation latency improved by ~12% under high-churn synthetic workload, and overall host-memory spill IO reduced by ~40% compared to previous naive spill implementation. End-to-end token cost for the benchmark decreased by ~6%.
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Please add metrics for defrag CPU/time cost and a guard to disable aggressive compaction under CPU pressure. Also prefer a deterministic compaction schedule to avoid background jitter.
Leah Chen (author): Added kv.defrag_cpu_usec and a cpu-pressure guard; compaction now runs on a token-count based scheduler to reduce jitter (see allocator changes).
Sofia Ruiz: The async spill writer should expose backpressure to the request path instead of silently dropping pages when queue is full. Also add observability for spill retries.

Leah Chen (author): Spill queue now signals backpressure; requests will mark segments as 'spill_pending' and the scheduler will favor eviction candidates while respecting soft-reservations. Added kv.spill_retries metric.

Leah Chen (author): Added e2e test turning on continuous batching and validating no in-flight evictions for pinned segments.

merge_commit_message:
kv-cache: defragmentation-aware eviction + spillover paging policy improvements

Includes allocator defrag, eviction scoring, async spillover, and scheduler pin integration. (ENG-2918, ENG-3084)
release_notes: Improves KV cache memory utilization by adding defragmentation-aware allocation and smarter eviction scoring; adds optional asynchronous spillover to host memory for cold segments; reduces tail latency under high-churn workloads. New telemetry: kv.fragmentation_ratio, kv.defrag_passes, kv.spill_io_write_bytes, kv.eviction_score_histogram.
notes: This change was intentionally conservative in defaults: spillover is disabled by default in Dedicated to avoid unexpected host IO. We plan a canary rollout for Hosted clusters with telemetry gating. Follow-up work: adaptive defrag tuning (ENG-3301) and NVMe-backed spill integration (ENG-3320).
